diagnosis_summary: A Rock maintainer closed issue 6921 because the narrow-viewport grid symptom had already been addressed by issue 6839. The earlier fix changes the shared virtual scroller so Grid ignores its internal horizontal scroll container when locating the vertical scroll container. The fix commit is directly linked to issue 6839, and both issues are currently labeled Fixed in v19.3.
workaround_summaries: Use a Rock build proven to contain commit d99159265a36b1adb17d09eec13cc4f69414c385, then verify a wide Obsidian Grid on a narrow viewport. Horizontal scrolling can force a temporary relayout on an affected build but is not a durable fix.

verification_playbook.goal: Determine whether a narrow-viewport Obsidian Grid still binds virtual rows to the wrong scroll container.
prerequisites: Choose an existing read-only grid with enough rows and columns to require both virtual and horizontal scrolling.

steps.title: Check build ancestry
steps.instructions: Confirm whether the installed build contains commit d99159265a36b1adb17d09eec13cc4f69414c385 or an equivalent virtual-scroll fix.
steps.expected_if_affected: The build predates the fix and Grid can select its internal horizontal container as the vertical scroll container.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: The build contains the fix and excludes Grid's horizontal container from vertical-scroll discovery.

steps.title: Observe a read-only narrow grid
steps.instructions: At a narrow viewport, scroll an existing read-only grid vertically without sorting, filtering, selecting, or editing. Record whether rows continue rendering before and after horizontal movement.
steps.expected_if_affected: Virtual rows stop rendering or leave blank space until horizontal scrolling forces a relayout.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: Rows continue rendering through vertical scrolling and horizontal movement is not required to restore them.
evidence_to_record: rows blank before horizontal scroll yes or no
rows restored after horizontal scroll yes or no

limitations: One grid configuration does not cover every custom cell renderer, sticky-header mode, or browser engine.

context.scope: Obsidian Grid virtual scrolling with wide columns on narrow browser viewports
official fix release line; verify the exact installed package
